name: T03 Browser recount: Portland 2024 District 1 STV
description: Recounting Portland's 43,669 ballots in the browser reproduces all 159 figures of the official 17-round report. The page also shows the build-time comparison; this test checks the one the browser itself produces.

planSteps.description: Scroll to the section titled "Check it yourself"
Click the "Recount in your browser" button in that section
Wait up to 60 seconds until that section shows a line starting with "Recount in your browser:"
The "Check it yourself" section shows "Recount in your browser: 159 of 159 figures match the official count."
The same section shows "Same winners, same 17 rounds"
